X (Twitter) · Organic Growth & Content
Mshel Homes — @MshelOfficial
Inherited a dormant account at 230 followers. Rebuilt the content strategy, voice, and publishing cadence. Grew engagement and reach entirely organically.
560%↑
Engagements
293%↑
Impressions
230→465
Followers grown

The brief

The account existed but had no consistent voice, no strategy, and low engagement. The challenge was making a real estate brand feel relevant and human on a platform where Nigerian audiences are highly opinionated and quick to scroll past corporate content.

What I built

Enforced a content pillar structure — informational posts about Nigerian real estate, emotional stories tied to homeownership, and restrained promotional content. Wrote every caption to match the platform's conversational tone. Managed all replies and DMs.

Results

  • 29.6K impressions — up 293%
  • 799 total engagements — up 560%
  • 374 likes — up 567%; 84 reposts — up 1K%
  • 168 profile visits — up 320%
  • Engagement rate: 2.6% — up 67%
  • Followers grown from 230 to 465 organically
  • Top post: 778K views, 414 likes, 50 bookmarks
  • Second post: 707K views, 457 likes, 85 bookmarks

Instagram · Organic Growth + Paid Ads
Mshel Homes Yola — Instagram
Took over a page with roughly 84 followers. Built content from scratch, ran targeted ads, and grew reach to over 119K — mostly non-follower reach.
2.2K%↑
New follows
119K

84→992

The brief

The Yola page was new and practically empty. The goal was to establish a consistent presence for Mshel Homes in the Yola market and grow an audience from scratch through organic content and paid promotion.

What I did

Ran targeted Meta Ads focused on profile visits and follower acquisition. Built content suited to the local market. 118,808 of the 119K reach came from non-followers — content consistently reaching new potential buyers.

Results

  • Grew from ~84 followers to 992 lifetime followers
  • 924 new follows — up 2,200%
  • Total reach: 119K — up 14,000%
  • Non-follower reach: 118,808
  • 56 new messaging contacts — up 100%

Meta Ads · Paid Campaign Management
Mshel Heritage Estate — Meta Ads Campaign
Ran a paid Meta Ads campaign for Mshel Heritage Estate focused on driving messaging conversations — direct inbound leads from potential buyers.
124

The brief

Drive qualified inbound conversations for Mshel Heritage Estate through a targeted Meta Ads campaign. The goal was messaging conversations — real potential buyers reaching out directly — not just impressions or clicks.

What I managed

Set up, monitored, and optimised the campaign across the 30-day period. Managed targeting, budget allocation, and performance tracking to keep cost per conversation efficient relative to the Nigerian real estate market.

Results

  • 124 messaging conversations started
  • ₦1,425.11 cost per messaging conversation
  • ₦176,713.81 total ad spend managed
  • Campaign period: Jul 27 – Aug 25, 2026
  • Objective: Direct lead generation via messaging

LinkedIn · Editorial Strategy & Long-form Content
Khadasha Innovations Africa
Built a 6-month content calendar and 10 long-form LinkedIn articles for a B2B advisory firm. Editorial work — not generic thought leadership, but posts timed to real conversations in African boardrooms.

The brief

Khadasha needed a LinkedIn presence that felt credible to African executives, HR leaders, and founders — not recycled Western career advice repackaged for Nigeria.

What I built

A 6-month editorial calendar structured around monthly themes tied to African business cycles. Ten long-form articles across three content pillars. A 5-day LinkedIn ad campaign for their executive talent placement service, sequenced as a daily narrative with escalating messaging.

Deliverables

  • 6-month editorial calendar with monthly thematic frameworks
  • 10 long-form LinkedIn articles across three pillars
  • 5-day sequenced LinkedIn ad campaign
  • Content written in the company's voice — not mine
  • All content grounded in African business context

Content samples

Live posts. Real captions. Real results.

Written, designed and published on the Mshel Homes X account.

Emotional · Lifestyle

"The Golf Course Gets You In. This Is What Keeps You There." — Led with convenience over prestige. Lifestyle-first framing for a luxury estate.

Informational · Investment

"The smartest buy in Wuye is the one nobody's talking about yet." — Positioned two estates as underrated investment plays near Abuja CBD.

Promotional · CTA

"Stop Thinking. Start Owning." — Addressed the psychological barrier of overthinking a property decision. Led with empathy, ended with urgency.

About

Who I am.

I'm a Social Media Manager based in Abuja, Nigeria, currently at Mshel Homes Limited — a real estate developer with properties across Abuja, Lagos, Kano, and Yola.

I came into this work through content management and stayed because I'm genuinely good at understanding what a brand needs to say — and finding the specific way to say it that doesn't sound like everyone else.

My strongest skill isn't scheduling or analytics, though I do both. It's writing in a brand's voice — researching the audience, understanding what actually moves them, and producing content that earns attention rather than begging for it.

I believe the compounding effect is what social media is really about. Not viral moments. Not trend-chasing. Consistent, researched, intentional stories — published long enough that the audience starts to trust you.
